params.name: name
params.description: A single name to predict nationality for. For batched lookups use the array form `name[]` repeated up to 10 times. Last names carry the strongest nationality signals; full names are also accepted and parsed automatically.

params.name: name[]
params.description: Batch form of the name parameter. Repeat up to 10 times to look up multiple names in a single request. Each name counts individually toward the monthly usage limit.

params.name: apikey
params.description: API authentication key. Required for paid plans and to track usage. Obtain at https://nationalize.io/login. The same key works across Genderize, Agify, and Nationalize.

items.docs: Predicts the nationality of one or more people based on their names, returning ranked country probabilities drawn from a dataset of approximately one billion people. Supports single name lookups, batched requests of up to 10 names, full name parsing, and diacritics handling. Results are returned as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes paired with probability scores, up to five countries per name.
